_comment: Frontend Agent Team defaults. A project may override any top-level key in <project>/.claude/frontend.json. Model tier names live in ~/.claude/backend/config.json; roles below map this team one by one.

fe-ui.down_to_sonnet_when: carrying out a decided change: a revision the user specified, syncing frames

fe-engineer.up_to_opus_when: feasibility and queue, cross-stack rows, client state or data layer, or a written invariant is touched

fe-tester.up_to_opus_when: writing a new assertion that must be shown to fail

model_tiering_rule: Judgement -> opus; carrying out a decided conclusion -> sonnet. Say which and why at each dispatch.

gates._comment: Human stops (PLAYBOOK §3F). UX applies only when state.json design_stops is 2.

design_stop_rule._comment: Two stops (UX, then UI) when the round has at least min_pages_for_two pages or a new flow; otherwise one. Proposed at kickoff, confirmed by the user.

figma._comment: PLAYBOOK §1E. Counts every Figma MCP call made by fe-ui and fe-engineer, logged on their returns.

parallelism._scaffold_comment: two-stop runs only; otherwise the scaffold is part of the prototype, Phase 2b (Constitution §4.2)

frontend_backend_boundary: Declared by the project, with who ruled it and a date, in <project>/.claude/project-context.md (default: ~/.claude/route/FRONTEND_BACKEND_LINE.md). The harness presets nothing; an unwritten line stops the queue.
